name: Research-pack loop failed — chain pause marker
description:
ADR-042 §Phase 2 redesign MVP-2 research pack failure handler. Fires when any research-pack role terminates with outcome=failed BEFORE emitting its decide() terminal — model timeout, NATS blip, OOM, panic, sandbox crash. Without this rule, the failure stalls the chain silently: no downstream rule fires, no operator surface lights up. Stamps a chain.paused.marker triple so operator dashboards (and MVP-5 mock-LLM journey assertions) can surface the pause and attach a recovery decision.

Pack-local mirror of configs/rules/chain/00-loop-failed-pause.json (the legacy chain-pause rule, which lists the ADR-041 roster's role tokens but NOT the new researcher-research-* tokens). Both rules co-exist in the source tree during MVP-2 through MVP-6 build-up; legacy chain-pause and its chainpause.Pauser §D5 subscriber retire alongside chain.mode in MVP-7 per ADR-042 §Phase 6. The pack-local rule retires the same day.

metadata.supersedes_legacy: configs/rules/chain/00-loop-failed-pause.json (scoped to research-pack roles only). Legacy rule's role list does NOT include the researcher-research-* tokens; without this pack-local mirror, a failed loop would die silently. Both retire together in MVP-7.
metadata.marker_only_note: Marker-only triple. Stamps chain.paused.marker with a timestamp object — does NOT write the full §D5 audit triple set (chain.paused.cause, .classification, .error_shape, etc.) that the legacy chainpause.Pauser NATS subscriber writes from parsing LoopFailedEvent.Error. For MVP-2 the marker alone is sufficient — UI / ops-observer queries on chain.paused.* find it. Full classification triples retire alongside chainpause in MVP-7 per ADR-042 §Phase 6; pack-local recovery dashboards (post-MVP-7) will read the marker + the original agent.failed.* event off the AGENT stream directly.
metadata.reviewer_pass_origin: Added 2026-05-17 per reviewer R2 (defensive coverage for MVP-6 real-LLM smoke). Without this rule a model timeout / 5xx / OOM during real-LLM smoke would silently wedge the chain; the marker gives MVP-5 journey assertions and MVP-6 operator-debug a foothold.
